title: Mother & Boy Holding Baby in Park, 1963 B&W Outdoor Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white square snapshot photo stamped August 1963 on the right margin. A smiling young boy proudly holds an infant baby while standing on a sunlit lawn surrounded by tall trees. A woman, likely his mother, bends down to support the baby's weight. The young boy wears a leather toy cowboy holster around his waist, a popular fashion accessory for children during the peak era of Western television shows in mid-century America.
